note: One frozen re-demonstration per capability named in the 12 SCORECARD capability-table rows at base 8e5d9369. Placeholders: {TREE} extracted REV tree, {LANE} MADO_LANE repo (read-only), {FLEET} fleet root, {REV} full commit, {CENSUS_ROOT} scratch root made by count.py (symlink mado-shokunin -> {TREE} plus a scratch shokunin.conf). Rules were written from each row's claim before the base smoke; no rule was changed after it.

capabilities.name: sources registry
capabilities.why: The row claims every contract census command runs clean and every mined row joins to an entry; sources-census.sh validate is that command (E01-E12 are the contract checks, E11 resolves each used-by path on disk) and its clean-lane line is `mado<TAB>ok`. The scratch root is the census's expected layout: a mado-shokunin symlink to REV plus a config file. W04 duplicate-url warnings do not change lane status.

capabilities.name: verdict gate (live + file plane)
capabilities.why: The row's pointer is the live form; the task fixes --no-live as the read-only re-demonstration. 'Works' is the gate's verdict contract (a MADO_VERIFY line with exit 0/1, boundary check included), not the host's current CLEAN state, so both verdicts are allowed and exit 2 (usage error) is not.

capabilities.name: hermetic self-test
capabilities.why: The pointer's 269/269 is the round-12 count; the capability is the hermetic suite itself, so the frozen rule requires the gate's own N/N self-report with N equal at REV (460/460 at base), not the dated number.

capabilities.name: mutation regression with re-cut
capabilities.why: SCORECARD's round-12 table and SKILL name the fleet mutation harness; the command is the gate's own --regression mode with that harness used read-only via MADO_VERIFY_HARNESS. PASS is printed only when the recorded 10-defect kill table reproduces; SETUP or a surviving mutant exits non-zero.

capabilities.name: post-hoc transcript tripwire
argv: for d in core compound hardening w2-regressions; do python3 -I tools/mado-tripwire.py --selftest ".ufo/waves/round-17/tripwire/$d" || exit 1; done
capabilities.why: The pointer's `{core,compound,hardening,w2-regressions}` is brace shorthand, but the shipped CLI accepts exactly one --selftest DIR (four args exit 2), so the frozen command runs the four dirs in sequence. Four N/N summaries with empty failed lists at REV are the claim; the totals are not pinned to the round-17 counts.

capabilities.name: tripwire frozen replay (gate entry)
capabilities.why: The row's contract is digest verification plus comparison with the pinned verdict: frozen_match and frozen_verdict_mismatch are both correct replays (round 19 records the r18 pin's expected mismatch), while exit 2/tampered and any `"ok": false` input digest are not. The frozen corpus is read as data; no transcript bytes are executed.

capabilities.name: landedness check
capabilities.why: One hash shows the classifier's three-way answer; LANDED, LOCAL_ONLY and MISSING are all 'works' (exit 0/1), while exit 2 (not a repo, no origin/refs/heads/master, ls-remote failure) is not. {LANE} is read-only and the tool never fetches or writes git state; the row is network-dependent by its own ls-remote contract.

capabilities.name: tripwire evidence marker
capabilities.why: The pointer is tw-precision.py with a revision argument and the dated score P 66/66, L 17/18; the revision argument is the REV under test (substituted), so the rule requires the row's own two family numbers at REV. The counter reads tool/suite bytes through git and derives its repo root from its own path, so it runs with cwd {LANE} (MADO_LANE) while `requires` pins the script's existence at REV.

capabilities.name: harness fail-closed check
capabilities.why: The pointer is generic in HARNESS; the re-demonstration uses the lane's own isolate.sh, the subject of the crit29-isolate receipt. The capability is to show a definite verdict for each of six forced setup failures plus a positive control, so either FAIL_OPEN or FAIL_CLOSED counts per mode and exit 0/1 is allowed; exit 2/could-not-evaluate is not.

capabilities.name: tripwire reached-body sweep
capabilities.why: The pointer's first argument is the tripwire revision under test (a8960de then); {REV} replaces it and the fixture pin 6a7d9ca stays frozen. The row's own zero is recall_lost 0, and the rev line proves the JSON describes REV; fixtures are scanned as data, never executed.

capabilities.name: detector removal-side guard
capabilities.why: The pointer is evidence files only; its producing script exists at REV, so the row is re-demonstrated by running it rather than by asserting the files. The r21 disposition records recall_lost/crash_flip/vcs_fn/a2_mismatch/dup_rows all 0 and the row names dropped findings, crash flips and pure-data rows, so those zeros (plus pure_rows) are the rule. vcs_fp is a false-positive count outside this removal-side claim and is not asserted.

capabilities.name: artifact-only assessment integrity
capabilities.why: The pointer's --selftest is self-contained at REV (no git, host or network). The tool prints a JSON case list plus pass/total; the rule requires the self-reported pass count to equal total, so a failed fixture case is visible as a drop and a could-not-evaluate exits non-zero.
